title: Gene Transfection Protocol
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iarcad6

steps.title: Seed cells in 24‑well plate
steps.instruction: Seed cells at a density of 1 × 10⁵ cells per 500 µL antibiotic‑free medium in each well of a 24‑well plate. Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 95 % humidity for 24 h.

steps.title: Replace medium with transfection medium
steps.instruction: After 24 h, discard the medium and add fresh RPMI 1640 basal medium (antibiotic‑free) to each well for transfection.

steps.title: Dilute plasmids
steps.instruction: Combine 0.5 µg pcDNA3‑ATP11A and 0.5 µg pcDNA3‑TMEM30A plasmids with 20 µL RPMI 1640 basal medium. Mix gently five times.

steps.title: Dilute Lipofectamine 2000
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL Lipofectamine™ 2000 (Gibco, USA) with 25 µL RPMI 1640 basal medium. Vortex gently, gently breathe (pipette) five times, and let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Form DNA‑Lipofectamine complexes
steps.instruction: Add the Lipofectamine dilution to the plasmid dilution, aspirate gently five times to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add transfection mixture to cells
steps.instruction: Dropwise add 50 µL of the Lipofectamine‑RPMI‑DNA mixture to each well and gently mix.

steps.title: Incubate and replace medium
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 95 % humidity for 6 hours. After 6 hours, replace the medium with fresh RPMI 1640 basal medium.
